nodes.name: Simulation Automation Module Design
nodes.summary: Design doc for a new `virtuoso sim` command subtree that automates ADE-L analog simulation by generating Ocean SKILL and dispatching it through the existing SKILL bridge. Defines the command tree (setup, run, sweep, corner, measure, results), typical workflows (single sim, parameter sweep, PVT corner analysis), a corner configuration file format, an Ocean SKILL generation architecture, error handling strategy, output format, and environment verification. Targets Cadence IC23.1 with Ocean API functions (simulator, design, analysis, run, openResults, getData, value, cross, ymax, ymin).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown design doc with command-tree ASCII art, code-fenced bash invocations, JSON/YAML corner-config examples, and SKILL code samples. 16 sections, ~200 lines, English.

nodes.name: Bayesian Optimization Skill for Circuit Auto-Tuning
nodes.summary: Approved design for a closed-loop Bayesian circuit auto-tuner implemented as a virtuoso-cli skill. Uses Claude itself as the surrogate (no external Python/ML deps), gm/Id + L as the parameter space, a hierarchical scoring function (feasibility first, then targets) aligned with spec template min/max/target structure, and a three-phase progressive PVT strategy (TT → FF/SS → temperature). Describes the suggest/simulate/measure/update iteration sequence, stopping criteria, JSON history file, and the catalogue of skill dependencies it composes.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with ASCII optimization-loop diagram, decision table, scoring hierarchy, English. 12 sections, ~130 lines.

nodes.name: sim run Robustness Fixes
nodes.summary: Task-by-task implementation plan to make `sim run` and `sim measure` detect and report failures instead of returning false success. Adds post-run validation in `src/commands/sim.rs` (verify run() return + spectre.out existence), diagnostic hints for all-nil measure results, a new `sim netlist` subcommand for programmatic netlist regeneration, and a SKILL-command guard for dangerous forms (e.g. exit, shell-out). Front-matter is targeted at Claude with a required sub-skill 'executing-plans'.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with four task sections, fenced Rust diff snippets, ASCII flow notes, English. 5 top-level sections, ~280 lines.

nodes.name: Borrow from virtuoso-bridge-lite — Review & Plan
nodes.summary: Cross-pollination review between virtuoso-cli and the sibling upstream virtuoso-bridge-lite. Documents which upstream features have already been adopted (cross-user daemon guard, profile-isolated scratch dirs, SKILL Finder + remote cache, parallel SpectreSimulator, maestro::snapshot, etc.) with adoption commits, then identifies four remaining gaps (X11/dialog deadlock bypass, .cdslck sniffer, knowledge transfer, digital-import edge cases) with concrete specs and an estimated-effort matrix. Also lists features that should NOT be adopted and open questions.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with multiple wide tables mapping upstream commits to local adoption commits, English. 11 sections, ~145 lines.

nodes.name: Design: Virtuoso-CLI AI Circuit Optimization Framework
nodes.summary: Builder-mode design doc (generated by /office-hours) framing the AI circuit optimization framework problem: analog designers currently hand-iterate simulate → tweak → re-simulate. Proposes an end-to-end auto-optimization approach that pairs LLM reasoning with gm/Id methodology over a virtuoso-cli Rust daemon + SKILL bridge, with auto pass/fail spec comparison. Wedge: Bandgap IP. Lists constraints, three considered approaches (batch automation, AI-assisted, end-to-end), recommended path, open questions, success criteria, and a distribution plan.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with bilingual headings (English titles, Chinese body in several sections), ASCII command sketches, English. ~145 lines.

nodes.name: Test Plan
nodes.summary: Engineering-review test plan generated by /plan-eng-review for the new modules introduced by the AI optimization framework: `src/spectre/batch.rs` (BatchSimulator), `src/optimizer/mod.rs` (Optimizer), `src/queue/mod.rs` (JobQueue), `src/spec/bandgap.rs` (BandgapSpec), and the existing PSF parser in `src/spectre/parsers.rs`. Specifies per-module test cases (empty ranges, template substitution, partial failure, timeout, PVT corner normalization, etc.), regression suite, critical failure-mode gaps (concurrent spectre job interference, dangling maestro sessions), and test execution procedure using `#[cfg(test)]` + `cargo test`.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with module-by-module test matrices, fenced test descriptions, English. 11 sections, ~155 lines.

nodes.name: virtuoso-cli AI-First EDA Infrastructure Enhancement Proposal
nodes.summary: External-style architecture assessment proposing to evolve virtuoso-cli from a string-bridge SKILL automation tool into a typed EDA platform / 'Agent Operating System'. Catalogues current strengths (session registry + dynamic port, JSON-first CLI, noun-verb structure, Rust choice), diagnoses the structural gap (abstraction layer too low), then lays out a phased roadmap: Phase 1 safety/stability (typed RPC layer, security hardening, MCP support), Phase 2 architecture (EDA object model, design diff engine, transaction/rollback), Phase 3 AI-native (graph-based design representation, simulation job system, TUI → EDA IDE). Closes with Cadence-version compatibility risks and contribution recommendations.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown written predominantly in Chinese (概述/评价/建议 sections) with English section/feature names; mixes prose, fenced bash, and wide proposal tables. 24 sections, ~320 lines, the largest doc in the batch.
